body.message:
Thank you. Just to clarify, is AED 29,537.72 the owner’s counteroffer to our AED 20,000 offer, or is this simply the standard system-generated rate for 25 nights?

Could you also please explain exactly how AED 29,537.72 was calculated? You previously confirmed a monthly rate of AED 25,000 for September and AED 33,000 for October. Even if these two monthly rates are applied pro-rata to the respective nights, the total for this period would be approximately AED 27,000, not AED 29,537.72.

We would actually be happy to book the apartment for a full 30-night monthly stay at the monthly rate. The only reason we are looking at 25 nights is because you have confirmed that the apartment is already booked after 23rd October, so a full 30-night stay starting on 28th September is simply not available to us.

Considering that we are willing to take the entire available period without any gaps, we would expect some flexibility rather than being charged a higher daily rate simply because the existing bookings prevent us from reaching 30 nights.

We specifically asked for the owner’s best counteroffer, rather than another standard quotation. Could you please confirm whether AED 29,537.72 was actually offered by the owner and provide the calculation behind this amount?
